title: Cairn plugin catalog index (schemaVersion 1)
description: The list of plugins Cairn offers to install from this catalog. Unknown fields are ignored, and Cairn skips entries whose type it doesn't understand.

id.description: Must equal the id inside the plugin file.

type.description: The kind of plugin. 'provider' adds model services (API plugins). Other kinds may be added later; Cairn skips types it doesn't understand. Must equal the type inside the plugin file.

source.description: 'official' for plugins maintained by Cairn, 'third-party' for plugins written by someone else. Must equal the source inside the plugin file.

author.description: Display name of the plugin's author or organization. Must equal the author inside the plugin file.

version.description: Must equal the version inside the plugin file.

homepage.description: The plugin's website, shown as a link. Must equal the homepage inside the plugin file. Also used for the favicon fallback.

urlOrPath.description: An https URL, or a path relative to index.json (no leading '/', no '..').
